page_title: BOL 2-0 TOR | Bologna v Torino 27/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+6' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Andrea Colombo had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Referee Andrea Colombo points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bologna players.
90+2' Attention! Referee Andrea Colombo straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
90+1' Goal! Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
90+1' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) has a goal ruled out for offside!
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
87' Great teamplay by Torino as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
81' We are about to witness a subsitution. Nikola Moro (Bologna) for Giovanni Fabbian.
81' Here is a change. Riccardo Calafiori is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna).
76' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Valentino Lazaro will be replaced by Yann Karamoh (Torino).
76' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' Riccardo Calafiori (Bologna) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Bologna force their opponents to concede a corner.
74' Pietro Pellegri (Torino) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
71' That's the end of the game for Karol Linetty, who is replaced by Gvidas Gineitis (Torino).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Kacper Urbanski (Bologna) will replace Alexis Saelemaekers.
70' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) replacing Adrien Tameze.
70' Duvan Zapata will be replaced by Pietro Pellegri (Torino).
69' This is a yellow card! Raoul Bellanova (Torino) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
62' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle for a foul. Valentino Lazaro (Torino) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
58' Bologna keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
56' 1 - 0 Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is released by Sam Beukema, he surges into the box and smashes a great shot into the net after a one-on-one with the goalkeeper.
56' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Victor Kristiansen and he is replaced by Jhon Lucumi (Bologna).
55' The manager makes a subsitution with Remo Freuler (Bologna) coming on for Michel Aebischer.
55' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Sam Beukema (Bologna), but it's just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
55' Good work from Bologna as they win a corner.
54' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
54' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raoul Bellanova (Torino).
52' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Nikola Vlasic (Torino). Andrea Colombo saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick to Bologna.

50' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Antonio Sanabria (Torino), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.

48' A sweet pass finds Ivan Ilic (Torino) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom right corner. Lukasz Skorupski is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
46' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. Torino are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
41' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
39' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Karol Linetty (Torino) was quite harsh and Andrea Colombo didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
35' A clumsy foul by Adrien Tameze (Torino) and Andrea Colombo blows his whistle. Bologna have a free kick.

31' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Torino win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal. Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
29' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) makes a strong challenge and Andrea Colombo blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Bologna.
27' Torino have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

26' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Torino have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
26' The ball is out of play and Torino manage to earn a corner.

24' Duvan Zapata (Torino) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the top right corner, but Lukasz Skorupski was alert and the score remains the same. The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
23' Yellow card. Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
21' Celebrations are cut short for Torino as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
20' Wait! Referee Andrea Colombo has indicated he is going to review the Torino goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

18' The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Nikola Vlasic (Torino) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a magnificent shot into the top left corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Lukasz Skorupski, so the score changes to 0:1.
18' Torino keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
14' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Dan Ndoye. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
12' Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) brings an opponent down and Andrea Colombo interrupts the game. Torino win a free kick.
11' Rough tackle by Alessandro Buongiorno (Torino). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Bologna, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
7' Raoul Bellanova (Torino) sends a cross in and finds Antonio Sanabria inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

5' Alexis Saelemaekers (Bologna) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Andrea Colombo stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Torino.
5' The resulting corner, taken by Michel Aebischer (Bologna), comes to nothing.

5' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Bologna will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

3' What a chance that is! Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Andrea Colombo is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
Show lineups
